name: vertex-abap
description: Versions/Reviewer, Data/Code Explorers + special mcp server

commands.title: Copy the MCP address for Claude Code or Codex

vertex.mcp.port.markdownDescription: Local MCP port for Codex, Claude Code and Copilot. Reload the window after changing it. Use a different port for each simultaneous VERTEX window; 0 selects a temporary port. The bearer token is kept in VS Code SecretStorage.

vertex.systems.markdownDescription: The ABAP systems this extension can read. One of them is active at a time - see `vertex.active`, or the **VERTEX: Switch System** command.

name.description: How this system is called in the switch list. Also what its stored password is filed under.

url.markdownDescription: Base URL, for example `https://host.example.com:44300`. This is the ICM port, not the one SAP GUI connects to.

client.description: SAP client, sent as sap-client. Leave empty to use the system default.

user.description: SAP user. The password is asked once and kept in the OS credential store, per system.

allowInsecureCertificate.markdownDescription: Accept a server certificate that cannot be verified. Development systems often have one. **Off by default on purpose** - turning it on disables certificate checking for requests to this system.

vertex.active.markdownDescription: Which of `vertex.systems` to read from. Empty means the first one.
